source.name: USDA Cropland Data Layer via CropScape, clipped per county

method: every 30 m pixel of the class, binned to a 0.03 degree grid, cells with at least 2 mapped acres kept
caveat: the 2024 crop year applied to 2026. Pulses sit in rotation, so this is where the crop was mapped, not where it is planted this season.
replaces: one point per county taken as the average of the county outline, which could be town, rangeland or another crop — named as a critical defect by independent review, September 2026
